description: This file defines the JotPadDashlet class, a custom dashlet component for SuiteCRM/SugarCRM, that provides a flexible, editable pad with configuration options and scripting support.

classes.name: JotPadDashlet
classes.description: A customizable dashboard widget allowing text editing, configuration, and dynamic scripting integration within SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet, loads language strings, sets default properties based on provided configuration.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the dashlet's HTML content, including template rendering and title display.

methods.name: displayScript
methods.description: Generates and returns the JavaScript code associated with the dashlet.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Provides the configuration form for the dashlet, allowing user customization.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Processes and saves user-defined configuration options for the dashlet.

methods.name: saveText
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to save the user's text input into the dashlet's stored options.
